results.question: 各门店销售额排名
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 华东区近30天销售额最高的门店是哪个
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region = '华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 各区域销售额占比
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER (), 2) as sales_pct FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(o.amount)) OVER ())::numeric, 2) as sales_pct FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 分析各区域销售额的同比变化
sqls: SELECT s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) as year, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) ORDER BY s.region, year
SELECT MIN(create_time) as min_time, MAX(create_time) as max_time FROM orders

WITH year_sales AS (
  SELECT s.region,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) as yr,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales
  FROM store s
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)
)
SELECT a.region,
       ROUND(COALESCE(b.sales,0),2) as sales_2025,
       ROUND(COALESCE(a.sales,0),2) as sales_2026,
       ROUND(COALESCE(a.sales,0) - COALESCE(b.sales,0),2) as yoy_growth,
       ROUND((COALESCE(a.sales,0) - COALESCE(b.sales,0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(b.sales,0),0), 2) as yoy_growth_rate
FROM year_sales a
LEFT JOIN year_sales b ON a.region = b.region AND a.yr = 2026 AND b.yr = 2025
WHERE a.yr = 2026
ORDER BY yoy_growth_rate DESC

results.question: 上月销售冠军门店的成功因素分析
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE o.create_time >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND o.create_time < date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) as refund_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)/COUNT(*),2) as avg_order FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE o.create_time >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND o.create_time < date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount, ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/COUNT(*))::numeric,2) as refund_rate, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)/COUNT(*))::numeric,2) as avg_order FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE o.create_time >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND o.create_time < date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1
